description: This file defines a Java interface 'ShareProductDataMapper' that uses MapStruct to map internal ShareProductData objects to their external Avro representation (ShareProductDataV1). It is part of the serialization layer for external event handling related to share products in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ShareProductDataMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface that converts ShareProductData to ShareProductDataV1 using predefined configuration.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a ShareProductData object to its Avro ShareProductDataV1 representation.
